entities.name: Turg
entities.description: A massive anurid frog beast psychically grafted to Laquatus as his servant, growing cunning and gaining spells before dying in a fight with a giant squid.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A merman and ambassador of the Mer Empire who controls Turg and schemes to obtain the Mirari.

entities.name: Mer Empire
entities.description: The empire Laquatus serves as ambassador.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: The city where Turg was put to use in the pits and which was devastated in the Battle for the Mirari.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The battle during which Cabal City was devastated.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A powerful orb that Laquatus, Kirtar, Kamahl and Seton chase, finally found by Emperor Aboshan.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A tall barbarian who fights Turg while chasing Kirtar.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A centaur who fights Turg and is nearly blinded by his acid.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: An aven lieutenant who plots a coup against Captain Pianna and holds the Mirari before Turg takes it.

entities.name: Captain Pianna
entities.description: The captain against whom Kirtar plots a coup.

entities.name: Satas
entities.description: A captain who creates a portal, takes the Mirari from Turg and hands it toward Emperor Aboshan.

entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: The increasingly paranoid emperor who finds the Mirari in the vaults and attempts to flood Otaria.

entities.name: Uurg
entities.description: A tadpole of Turg's clutch that escaped the Cabal and now roams Otaria.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The land where the events take place.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The group that intended to use Turg's eggs to create more pit-fighters.

entities.name: Krosan Dragon
entities.description: A dragonette eaten by Turg, whose call drew a full-grown Krosan Dragon that damaged the city.

events.summary: Turg is captured and psychically grafted to Laquatus, becoming more intelligent.
events.quote: rigorously trained to be Laquatus's servant by being psychically grafted to the merman

events.summary: Turg eats a Krosan dragonette, whose call draws a full-grown dragon to devastate Cabal City.
events.quote: Turg was partly responsible for causing the devastation of the city

events.summary: Turg first fights Seton and Kamahl while Laquatus pursues Kirtar across Otaria's northern plains.
events.quote: Turg briefly fought them but withdrew at Laquatus's command

events.summary: Turg wrestles Seton in Krosa and blinds him nearly with vomited acid before retreating.
events.quote: Turg vomited on Seton's face and retreated

events.summary: At the Order's citadel, Turg fights Kamahl, then takes the Mirari from Kirtar but mistakenly hands it to Satas.
events.quote: Turg then mistakenly gave the orb to Satas

events.summary: Laquatus makes himself central to Aboshan's court and uses Turg to arrest and frame his enemies.
events.quote: Laquatus maneuvered to make himself central to the court under the pretext of rooting out traitors

events.summary: Aboshan finds the Mirari in the vaults and prepares to flood Otaria; Laquatus and Turg fight the guards.
events.quote: Aboshan decided to inspect the vaults, where he found the Mirari

events.summary: Turg is torn apart by a giant squid but kills it as well.
events.quote: he managed to slay the creature as well

events.summary: Turg's eggs yield a tadpole, Uurg, who escapes the Cabal and roams Otaria.
events.quote: one of the tadpoles escaped their control

relations.quote: rigorously trained to be Laquatus's servant
Laquatus served as the Mer Empire 's ambassador in Cabal City
The two fought, with Turg's camouflage making him nearly invisible in the darkened room.
When Turg perished, he left behind a clutch of eggs.
